text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? What's this thread? "Between C.B. 
and Rudolf, who's actually stronger?"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Rudolf's the strongest, hands down." "CB 
gambles too much." "Yeah, but CB is way 
more fun to watch." "Rudolf is definitely 
taking the Triple Crown."

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... wow, opinions are cleanly split 
down the middle. Well, I guess that makes 
sense.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if they'll clash in this year's 
Arima Kinen. Man, I can't wait to see them 
raceâhuh!?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"‘Looks like we're clashing in the next 
event tournament.’ Seriously!?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Event-by-Event Meet is an academy 
tournament where all enrolled Umamusume 
can freely choose their races, regardless 
of distance, turf, or dirt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Generally speaking, many Umamusume run in 
it to explore new possibilities for 
themselves, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. There's no way we could miss a race 
with both Ace and Rudolf in it!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I can't sit still. I wish the race would 
just start already.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This time, the decision to enter was made 
because Mr. C.B. wished for it!

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"This lineup feels just like a GⅠ race. CB 
and Rudolf... I wonder which one will 
win?"

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"CB has the legs to win, as long as she 
doesn't take crazy gambles. I even sent 
her an advice letter... She's definitely 
going to win today!"

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now then, held a month earlier than usual, 
it's the Specialty Event Tournament. 
Umamusume competitors, please head to the 
waiting room following the announcement—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Murmur murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, I have a race in the afternoon as 
well. I was hoping to leave that area in 
your hands.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you. ...Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Rudolf. You look busy. There are way 
more media folks around compared to 
previous years."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, there's a feature race this 
time around.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, nice to meet you today. I believe 
we're slated to run in the same race.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, same here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. takes Symboli Rudolf's right 
hand... and then,

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...And who are you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The one screaming was... that brown-haired 
young man who shows up from time to time.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, sorry! I'm just a spectator. Seeing 
the two headliners shaking hands before 
the race just completely blew me away...!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so the "feature race" was referring to 
our race after all.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Isn't that obvious!?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
CB-san goes without saying—her prowess is 
so great that people expect a brand-new 
myth from her!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Rudolf-san is an undefeated Double Crown 
Umamusume! The strongest contender for the 
Triple Crown, already hailed as the 
strongest of her generation—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Even you, Ace-san, have been on an 
unstoppable rise ever since the Takarazuka 
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
A race where those three clash is 
something you rarely ever get to witness, 
even in a GⅠ!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, as long as everyone's 
having fun, I guess it's all good.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Things are already super hyped up!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh, right, excuse me! Could I maybe get 
a quick comment from you? It's for an 
UmaTube video, you see...”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, sure!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we moved to a slightly different 
spot and agreed to a brief interview.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
I imagine you're both conscious of each 
other going into this race—do you have any 
specific plans in mind?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I cannot share the details here. 
However, I have committed all of her 
strategies to memory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I do intend to devise a strategy. ...How 
about you, CB?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"I won't know till I try running, after 
all. I'll just burst forward the moment it 
feels right!"

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat!? But your opponent is... *her*, 
you know? She's not someone you can just 
overpower with raw talent...

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Don't you ever adjust your racing style to 
your opponents, like Rudolf-san does? That 
would improve your win rate—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's no fun if everything is decided ahead 
of time. I want to run freely.

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Freedom... I see... But—

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Attention, all participating Umamusume: 
Please gather at the staging area—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Well, I gotta be going soon. See you 
later, kiddo!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...! Thank you very much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving behind the young man who still 
looked like he wanted to say something, 
the highly anticipated clash between Mr. 
C.B. and Symboli Rudolf began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —However...

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Rounding the 4th corner, now into the 
decisive straightaway!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace commands a three-length 
lead! Mr. C.B. is still bringing up the 
rear, while Symboli Rudolf holds the 
outside in midfield!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
C-C.B.! Hang in there—! Crap, is she 
seriously not gonna make it in time!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Remaining positioned at the very rear, Mr. 
C.B. was struggling to move forward.

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace holds on in the lead! Where 
is Mr. C.B.—?!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. is still in the middle of the 
pack! Symboli Rudolf moves from third to 
second—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Event Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Katsuragi Ace pulls off the wire-to-wire 
victory! She crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
K-Katsuragi Ace!? No way, where are CB and 
Rudolf!?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...! ALRIGHTTTTTT--!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Total defeat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
We're still far from ready to go 
toe-to-toe with them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Should we reconsider the races after the 
Kikuka-sho? ...Entering the Japan Cup 
might also be a bit... under current 
conditions—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa... gh!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, too late...!! *sigh*... That 
frustrates me...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Still, yeah... Now I'm starting to get 
fired up...! Hehe!"

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan A
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B. suffered a crushing defeat... !?

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
“No way, w-why...!? There's no way she 
places 10th with this lineup!!”

text_block_list.name: C.B. Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look at him, he's laughing... How 
can you even laugh at a time like 
this...?!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong with you, aren't you 
frustrated at all...?

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Don't you wanna win?! Why the hell not?! 
You're the strongest Umamusume in history, 
aren't you...?!
